design.summary: Host-only checked helper and immutable container mount snapshot, CAS settings and independent Docker read-only binds

implementation.summary: Settings, active-root browser, native helper, launcher, build and marketplace integration; independent review fixes #11/#13

documentation.summary: PRD, test boundaries, rollback and issue-first development workflow recorded

cleanup.summary: Owned UI fixture container, browser, TLS proxy and native helper stopped; local evidence preserved; production and original dirty checkout unchanged

release_authorization: User requested pushing completed code and releasing ready plugins. This ledger covers source delivery only; production restart and new Aide release archive are separate outcomes.

handoff: Production localhost:9999 remains old image. Windows physical picker/multi-drive and removable-drive unplug require follow-up acceptance; current test evidence is isolated.
